artifact: Configuration composition exploration, not runtime screenshot
scope: All four V2 config modes; regrouping and disclosure changes allowed; preserve music, scoring, valid autosave and records
prompt:
Design a polished Jazz Ear Lab V2 configuration screen comparison board, OPTION B — OVERVIEW AND INLINE EDITING. Desktop landscape viewport on left and true narrow portrait mobile viewport on right. Board labels outside frames: B — OVERVIEW + INLINE EDIT, Desktop, Mobile. NO browser URL/address bars, no device hardware, no perspective. App chrome only. Use reference for identity only: near-black header, Source Sans3 humanist sans, yellow #f8d808 primary action, cool open #f5fbfe background, white native fields, gray thin separators, flat modest square corners. Actual visible navigation Jazz Ear Lab / Practice / Insights / Legacy, mobile on TWO lines with all nav links visible, no hamburger.

Real surface is Progression Recognition configuration, saved preset Recognition. Current values Major ii–V–I Dm7,G7,Cmaj7, each4beats,80BPM,2notes/chord,10questions,overall volume60%,all five voice gains100%. Four sections Harmony, Target degrees, Practice, Sound. Same settings and music as any other concept; this alternative's composition must be genuinely different.

STRUCTURE: one CENTERED VERTICAL column, about960px desktop, NO sidebars, NO tabs or wizard, NO multiple-card dashboard. Header Customize progression, subtitle Progression Recognition, preset selector Recognition and a quiet Save as new preset. Under heading a compact full-width plain summary line "Dm7 → G7 → Cmaj7 · 80 BPM · 2 notes/chord · 10 questions" and Saved to Recognition. Then FOUR stacked flat accordion sections; every section header includes a readable summary even while collapsed, with a labelled Edit action or disclosure arrow. Show Harmony COLLAPSED with visible summary "Dm7 → G7 → Cmaj7 / 4 beats each / Transpose 0". Show Target degrees EXPANDED and truly editable. In it, show three non-selectable QUALITY LABELS m7,7,maj7 each with its current selected degree text (m7:1,b3,5,b7;7:3,b7,9;maj7:1,3,5,maj7). The m7 row has a FULL EXPANDED DEGREE CHECKBOX GRID containing all18 real choices:1,b9,9,b3,#9,3,11,#11,b5,5,b13,13,b7,maj7,4,6,bb7,#5, with ONLY1,b3,5,b7 checked. Static m7 label, NO checkbox that enables/disables a quality: progression qualities come from its chords. Other two quality rows remain concise with small Edit degrees disclosures. Practice COLLAPSED summary "80 BPM · 2 notes per chord · 10 questions". Sound COLLAPSED summary "5 voices at100% · Overall volume60%". A simple bottom action row has quiet saved state and yellow Start practice; separate subordinate Past progression sessions disclosure. No save-submit form button (settings auto-save). No "Next step", no new grading feature or newly invented shortcuts.

Mobile follows same centered single-column overview+accordion model, selected m7 degree grid wraps into four columns with comfortable native checkboxes and legible labels; compact summaries remain readable; Start practice in a reserved white bottom action area, not covering form contents. Convey that users see WHAT is configured at a glance and expand only the detail they wish to change. This must be a production-quality calm OPERATE interface with strong section hierarchy and real musical content, no gradients, shadows, charts, waveforms or decoration.
